clips.narration: This is what happened when the mountain stopped playing fair.
clips.caption: WHAT JUST HAPPENED?
clips.evidence: Bright snowy airborne fall-like action begins near 67:27.

clips.narration: It started with a wall almost hidden by snow.
clips.caption: BARELY ANY VISIBILITY
clips.evidence: Character climbing barely visible snowy rock.

clips.narration: Every move meant reaching for another tiny icy ledge.
clips.caption: ONE HOLD AT A TIME
clips.evidence: Character navigates small ice holds near cliff.

clips.narration: And the climb just kept getting harder to read.
clips.caption: WHERE IS THE NEXT HOLD?

clips.narration: Then the scene opened into something I did not expect.
clips.caption: THEN THE DROP...
clips.evidence: Icy gap and the shift toward bright airborne shot.

clips.narration: That transition is wild. Subscribe for more.
clips.caption: THE MOUNTAIN IS WILD
clips.evidence: Colorful blue-violet airborne effect after icy traverse.
